title: Race conditions in 60 seconds
caption: Race conditions in 60 seconds: the bug that only shows up when two things happen at once.

scenes.code:
A reads balance: 100
B reads balance: 100
A writes 100 - 80 = 20
B writes 100 - 80 = 20

→ 160 spent from 100
scenes.say: Two withdrawals arrive at the same moment. Both read a balance of a hundred, both approve, and you've paid out a hundred and sixty.
It's a nasty kind of bug.

items.title: Hidden
items.say: So tests almost never catch it.

scenes.say: The fix is to make check and change one step: a lock, a transaction, or a single atomic update.
That's a race condition. Check and change in one step.
